ankleSetup: Ikala maaũ mĩolokete. Tindĩka tũno twa maaũ mbele, ĩndĩ ũtũkũte nyuma.
aquaticSetup: Maaĩnĩ mataasa, ĩka kana ũkavitha maaũ manini ũteithĩtw'e.
aquaticSub: Endea kana kĩka mau maanzĩ manini.
armLibraryCopy: Mwongozo wa kwosa moko na kũkinya ũlaĩ wa kĩvako kwa ũsũngĩo.
armSetup: Mwĩĩ wa iulu woneke. Kana akose woko kinzũni kya mbalũni.
balanceGameSub: Ikala wĩ mũima nĩ kana ũsũmbany'e mbete sya balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Mwongozo wa kwĩthũkĩsya balance na ũtethyo kwa ũsũngĩo.
balanceSetup: Mwĩĩ w'onthe wonany'e. Mwana aikale wĩ mũima, mũsuvĩĩi akĩĩ vakuvi.
ball-throwSetup: Ĩkala mpilanĩ wa therapy ũteithĩtw'e. Tava na ũkwate mpila mũlũngũ.
ballThrowSetup: Ikala mbungonĩ ya therapy wĩ na ũtethyo. Ikũnya na ũkwate mbungo itee.
beadsSetup: Kwatĩĩla mũko mũthithu na ũthĩĩsye shanga nene ĩmwe ĩmwe.
bilatSetup: Mũthĩĩsye atũmĩe moko o meeli vamwe — kĩthũa, kwĩkĩla, kana kũvingithya mbungo.
breathingSetup: Koma kana ĩkala wĩ o nesa. Ĩkĩa kwoko ĩvunĩ na ũveve kavola.
breathingSub: Veva mũno na kavola, kwoko ĩvunĩ.
bridgeSetup: Koma na mũongo, mavĩĩ makũnĩte. Inũa ikũngũ kavola ũtunge ndaraja.
bridgeSub: Inũa ndaraja nĩ kana ngalawa ĩvite.
brushSetup: Tũmĩa brush mũlũngũ. Kwakũa moko na maaũ vanini o ta ũla therapist watongoiw'e.
brushSub: Kũkwakũa moko na maaũ na vinya.
buttonsSetup: Tũmĩa dressing board yĩ na vitũmbĩ nene. Ĩthũkũma kũvunga na kũvungũa.
catchSetup: Kumba mbila ĩteketeke o kavola, ũsumbĩ wa kĩthũa. Mwana aĩkwate na moko elĩ.
clapSetup: Syũka kamera. Kavya o mbele wa kĩthũa ĩla syĩlĩlo yambiĩa kũmetha.
crawlSetup: Thengeesya vandũ va kwĩkaata ve kĩndũ kĩteketeke. Mũĩkĩe vinya ekate ethiĩ kĩndũnĩ kĩla endete kwĩthaa nakĩ.
cutSetup: Kwatĩĩla makasi ma ũtangi ũteithĩtw'e. Kenga ũatĩĩĩe mũsyaĩ waĩle na ũlũngalalu.
dailyPlan: Mũbango wa therapy wa o mũthenya
dailyPlanCopy: Kĩthaasya session ĩmwe ya moko, ĩmwe ya maaũ, na ĩmwe ya balance na ũtethyo wa mũlea.
drawSetup: Tũmĩa crayon ĩkalatasinĩ, kana kwala mĩthemba ũĩanĩ na kyaala.
dressSetup: Tũmĩa mbau ya kwĩmanyĩsya ĩna matungo manene na zipu.
feedSetup: Ikya bead nini kĩikonĩ. Mwana aĩtw'ae ate kũmĩthasya.
gaitLibraryCopy: Mwongozo wa kũthiĩ na ũtethyo na kũmanyĩsya kũsua matambya.
gaitSetup: Thambya nzĩa ĩĩ salama. Tavya mbele kavola ũĩ na ũtethyo.
gripSetup: Tũmĩa siponji ĩteketeke kana stress ball. Kamua, kwata kwa sekondĩ 3, ĩtĩkĩla.
guidedSetup: Syĩa kana mwana nĩwoneka kamelanĩ na ũũmĩe mwongozo wa mũsuvii.
half-kneelSetup: Ĩkĩa iviimo yĩmwe thĩ, na kũũ kũngĩ kũikye nthi vau mbee. Kwatĩĩla ũteithĩtw'e.
halfKneelSetup: Ĩka ĩvĩĩ yĩmwe nthĩ, na kũũ kũngĩ kwĩkale nthĩ mbee. Ikala ũu wĩ na ũtethyo.
halfKneelSub: Ĩvĩĩ yĩmwe nthĩ, na kũũ kũngĩ mbee.
handwritingSetup: Tũmĩa kyaĩ kana krayoni kũatĩĩĩa mĩsyaĩ, mavilingo na mĩsalaba.
headSetup: Tetheesya mwana aikale. Thamya kindũ kĩng'aaĩte kavola nĩ kana akĩtetheesye na metho.
headSub: Tetheesya ndũũngũ ĩla ĩthama na metho maku.
heel-raiseSetup: Kwatĩĩla rail. Inuka na tũthũngũsĩ twa maaũ, ũkwatĩĩle, ĩndĩ ũthũwe kavola.
heelRaiseSetup: Ĩkĩla mũkanda. Ĩmĩla na isemba sya mau, ikala ũu, ĩndĩ ũsũlũke kavola.
heelRaiseSub: Ĩmĩla na isemba sya mau, ĩndĩ ũsũlũke.
horseSetup: Ĩkala ũtambalĩte bolster nene kana mpila wa peanut. Kwatĩĩla ũilye ũu ĩla ũkĩthũngĩĩsya o vanini.
kneelingSetup: Kũnĩla ũthingithĩni mũtee, nyonga syĩ iulu wa mavĩĩ. Ikala ũu wĩ na ũtethyo.
kneelingSub: Kũnĩla wĩ wĩmĩte na ũikale wiĩkĩte.
langFallbackNote: UI nĩ ya Kĩngeresa ĩvinda ya utaũlo wa {lang} ũendee kwĩthondekwa.
legGameSub: Kava na kũũ ũelekea ndũũngũ ĩla ĩng'aaĩte o ngalĩ ĩngĩ.
legLibraryCopy: Maũndũ ma PT: ĩkala wĩ mũthyũlũ wa kũu na kũu na mũtwe wa mũtwe, ĩta kũu na kũu na mũtwe wa mũtwe, mũlea akũtethye kuma itina ethĩwa no nginya.
legSetup: Ngama na kũũ kũla kwĩ na vinya mũnini, ũkwatie kĩngũ. Kava ndũũngũ na kũũ kũngĩ.
librarySub: Video na maũndũ ma kwongela kũsoma
marchSetup: Kwata kĩvĩla kĩkũtetheesye. Inũa mavĩĩ ĩmwe ĩmwe nginya ũasa wa ikũngũ kũlingana na mũumo.
marchSub: Thiĩ ta asikalĩ kũlingana na mũumo wa ngoma.
midlinePrompt: Ũlũma nginya ngw'ambu ĩngĩ ya mwĩĩ waku
midlineSetup: Ikya syĩlĩlo ngw'ambunĩ ĩngĩ ya mwĩĩ. Mwana alũme akĩla katĩ wa mwĩĩ.
midlineSub: Ũlũma nginya ngw'ambu ĩngĩ ya mwĩĩ.
obstacleSetup: Ĩka indo nini itee mũlainĩ. Nyanga ũkĩla o kĩmwe wĩ na ũtethyo.
oralSetup: Tũmĩa straw kana kamũko ka bubbles. Vuva vanini nĩguo ũvinye mĩĩ ya kana.
oralSub: Vuva bubbles kana ũnyue na straw.
pinchSetup: Ikya beads/pom-poms thalanĩ. Mwana athinye na kyaala kĩnene na kyaala kĩngĩ.
playdoughSetup: Tũmĩa play dough mũlũngũ. Vilingĩsya, minya na ũkamue na moko eli.
pnfSetup: Ĩtĩla kwoko nthĩ na ng'ambo ĩngĩ ya mwĩĩ, ĩndĩ yĩĩlũ na nza.
pnfSub: Thingithya kwoko na nzĩla ya kũminyĩka.
proneSetup: Lala na ĩvu. Ĩkĩla moko ma nthĩ na ũlaa mũtwe na kĩthũa.
proneSub: Ũlaa mũtwe na kĩthũa wĩlala na ĩvu.
puzzleSetup: Oya umbo na ũkĩĩkye ĩtondonĩ ya umbo ũsu.
reachSetup: Ĩka toy ĩtũngĩte va ũlaĩ wa kĩvako. Kana akinye kwake.
rollingSetup: Lala ũthingithĩni. Vilinga kavola kuma mũongo kũthi ĩvu, na ũvoye.
rollingSub: Vilinga kuma mũongo kũthi ĩvu, na ũvoye.
safetyNote: Tũma ethĩwa kwĩ na ũũi, kĩsungũsungũ, kana ũnovu ũtamekete.
sensorySetup: Ĩkĩĩthĩsye mĩkwato 3 (mũteketeke, mũũ, na wa tũvũngũ). Mwana akwate o ũmwe.
sensorySub: Kwata kĩteketeke, kĩkũmu, na kĩna tũvũngũ.
shoulderSetup: Ikala kana ũngeme wĩ mwoloku. Thũngũsya mabeka me mbele, yiulu, nyuma, na nthĩ.
sidelyingSetup: Lala na mbavu wĩ na ũtethyo. Tũmia moko o meeli kũtheka na kĩtheko.
sidelyingSub: Theka na moko o meeli wĩlala na mbavu.
simonSetup: Mũĩmĩi aasya mĩĩko. Mwana eka o ĩla Simon waasya.
simonSub: Ĩka wĩko ũsu ĩla Simon waasya.
sitstandSetup: Ikala kĩvĩlanĩ kĩĩ na vinya, maaũ maĩ nthĩ. Ngama kavola, ĩndĩ ũikale ĩngĩ.
squatSetup: Maaũ maĩ ũasa wa mabeka, kwata kĩngũ, kũna mavĩĩ vanini na ĩndĩ ũnange.
step-upSetup: Tũmĩa katambĩ kanini ke na rail. Nyanya na kũũ, ĩndĩ ĩla ĩngĩ.
stepUpSetup: Tũmia katũmbĩ kanini ke na mũkanda. Nyanga yĩĩlũ na kũũ kũmwe, ĩndĩ kũngĩ.
stepUpSub: Nyanga yĩĩlũ na nthĩ wa katũmbĩ kanini.
stretchSetup: Nolola mĩsũkĩ ĩla mĩkũni na ũtethyo, kavola. Kwata o mũnololo sekondi 15–20.
toiletSetup: Ĩmanyĩsye kila mũtambũkĩle wa kwenda kyoo ũteethĩtwe nĩ mũtheeasya.
toiletSub: Ĩmanyĩsye kũĩkũlya ngũa, kũikala, kwĩthya na kũthamba moko.
trackSetup: Mutwe ũikaly'e o vala. Atĩĩa kĩndũ kĩendee kavola na metho o meka.
trunkSetup: Ikala wĩ mwoloku. Thũngũsya mwĩĩ wa yiulu kw'oko kwa aka na kwa aume kavola.
videoPlaceholder: Video yaku ya kwongela kũsoma nĩyooneka vaa.
wall-standSetup: Ũkĩla mũongo na mbĩndĩ sya maaũ ikwatanĩte na ũkũta. Kwatĩĩla ũteithĩtw'e.
wallStandSetup: Ĩmĩla mũongo na itina sya mau syĩkĩte kĩvĩmbĩnĩ. Ikala ũu wĩ na ũtethyo.
